svg.title: Combined Account Contribution topography
svg.desc: Combined Account Contribution topography. 01 June 2018 to 31 May 2026. 6,715 supplied contributions across 1,658 listed dates. 8 annual plates, each read from June at left to May at right. Crystal height is linear in the daily count on a common scale, from 0 to 7. Unlisted dates remain empty grid gaps; they are not confirmed zero. This is the profile owner's supplied contribution archive.
